//@version=5
strategy("Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout Redesign 2", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(5, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")
// ===== SESSION =====
use_session   = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr   = input.int(16,  "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute")
sess_bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
sess_bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
sess_bar_t = sess_bar_hr * 100 + sess_bar_mn
sess_clock_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
sess_clock_end = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn
in_session = not use_session or (sess_clock_start > sess_clock_end ? (sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_start or sess_bar_t < sess_clock_end) : (sess_bar_t >= sess_clock_start and sess_bar_t < sess_clock_end))
if not in_session
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session")



// ===== INPUTS =====
profile_lookback = input.int(100, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=10, maxval=500)
poc_zone_pct     = input.float(10.0, "POC Zone % of Range", minval=1.0, maxval=50.0)
delta_min_pct    = input.float(10.0, "Min POC Delta %", minval=0.0, maxval=100.0)
vwma_len         = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1, maxval=500)
pivot_len        = input.int(5, "Pivot Length", minval=1, maxval=50)
use_reversal     = input.bool(false, "Use Reversal Logic")

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
ny_time     = time(timeframe.period, "0000-2359", "America/New_York")
ny_hour     = hour(ny_time, "America/New_York")
ny_minute   = minute(ny_time, "America/New_York")
is_flatten_time = (ny_hour == 16 and ny_minute == 0)

// ===== TREND FILTER =====
vwma_val   = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
trend_long  = close > vwma_val
trend_short = close < vwma_val

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE CALCULATION =====
int bin_count = 50
var array<float> up_vols   = array.new_float(bin_count, 0.0)
var array<float> down_vols = array.new_float(bin_count, 0.0)

for i = 0 to bin_count - 1
    array.set(up_vols, i, 0.0)
    array.set(down_vols, i, 0.0)

float high_range = ta.highest(high, profile_lookback)
float low_range  = ta.lowest(low, profile_lookback)
float range_size = high_range - low_range
float bin_size   = range_size > 0 ? range_size / bin_count : 1.0

for i = 0 to profile_lookback - 1
    float price = close[i]
    int bin_idx = math.floor((price - low_range) / bin_size)
    if bin_idx < 0
        bin_idx := 0
    if bin_idx >= bin_count
        bin_idx := bin_count - 1
    float vol = volume[i]
    if close[i] > open[i]
        array.set(up_vols, bin_idx, array.get(up_vols, bin_idx) + vol)
    else
        array.set(down_vols, bin_idx, array.get(down_vols, bin_idx) + vol)

int poc_idx = 0
float max_vol = 0.0
for i = 0 to bin_count - 1
    float total_vol = array.get(up_vols, i) + array.get(down_vols, i)
    if total_vol > max_vol
        max_vol := total_vol
        poc_idx := i

float poc_price      = low_range + (poc_idx + 0.5) * bin_size
float poc_zone_width = range_size * (poc_zone_pct / 100.0)
float poc_zone_high  = poc_price + poc_zone_width
float poc_zone_low   = poc_price - poc_zone_width

float poc_up_vol    = array.get(up_vols, poc_idx)
float poc_down_vol  = array.get(down_vols, poc_idx)
float poc_total_vol = poc_up_vol + poc_down_vol
float poc_delta     = 0.0
if poc_total_vol > 0
    poc_delta := (poc_up_vol - poc_down_vol) / poc_total_vol * 100.0

// ===== ARMING LOGIC =====
var bool armed_long   = false
var bool armed_short  = false
var bool reversal_allowed = false
var int  last_exit_dir    = 0

bool inside_poc_zone = close >= poc_zone_low and close <= poc_zone_high

if close > poc_zone_high and trend_long and poc_delta >= delta_min_pct
    armed_long := true
    armed_short := false
    reversal_allowed := false

if close < poc_zone_low and trend_short and poc_delta <= -delta_min_pct
    armed_short := true
    armed_long := false
    reversal_allowed := false

if inside_poc_zone
    armed_long := false
    armed_short := false

// ===== PIVOT LOGIC =====
var float last_pivot_high = na
var float last_pivot_low  = na

ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_len, pivot_len)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivot_len, pivot_len)

if not na(ph)
    last_pivot_high := ph
if not na(pl)
    last_pivot_low := pl

// ===== ENTRY CONDITIONS =====
bool long_entry_sig  = false
bool short_entry_sig = false

if strategy.position_size == 0
    if armed_long and not na(last_pivot_high) and close > last_pivot_high
        long_entry_sig := true
    if armed_short and not na(last_pivot_low) and close < last_pivot_low
        short_entry_sig := true
    if use_reversal and reversal_allowed
        if last_exit_dir == 1 and not na(last_pivot_low) and close < last_pivot_low
            short_entry_sig := true
            reversal_allowed := false
        if last_exit_dir == -1 and not na(last_pivot_high) and close > last_pivot_high
            long_entry_sig := true
            reversal_allowed := false

// ===== STOP-OUT / REVERSAL TRACKING =====
var int prev_pos_size = 0
if strategy.position_size != prev_pos_size
    if prev_pos_size > 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
        float last_trade_pnl = strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1)
        if last_trade_pnl < 0
            last_exit_dir := 1
            if use_reversal
                reversal_allowed := true
    if prev_pos_size < 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
        float last_trade_pnl = strategy.closedtrades.profit(strategy.closedtrades - 1)
        if last_trade_pnl < 0
            last_exit_dir := -1
            if use_reversal
                reversal_allowed := true
prev_pos_size := strategy.position_size

// ===== EXECUTION =====
if long_entry_sig
    if in_session
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)

if short_entry_sig
    if in_session
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

if is_flatten_time and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session End")

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", color.blue, linewidth=2)
plot(poc_price, "POC", color.red, style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(poc_zone_high, "POC Zone High", color.orange, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(poc_zone_low, "POC Zone Low", color.orange, style=plot.style_linebr)
plotshape(long_entry_sig, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_entry_sig, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)
bgcolor(armed_long ? color.new(color.green, 90) : armed_short ? color.new(color.red, 90) : na)
